title: Canonical derived global germs
statement: The global germ Γ(Y,F) → F_t is evaluation on the identity etale neighbourhood followed by the germ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For g:Y′→Y transport the germ at t∘g through the inverse-image stalk isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image]. Derive these natural transformations, identify right derivation of the exact stalk functor with its induced functor on D⁺ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and precompose inverse Leray [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit] to obtain canonical maps RΓ(X,K) → D(stalk_t)(Dg⁻¹(Rf_*K)) and RΓ(X,K) → D(stalk_t)(Rf_*K).
